concerns.text: Task T016 mandates fetching the visual dataset via `huggingface_hub` with ID 'openneuro/ds', contradicting the Spec (FR-001) and Plan which mandate `mne.datasets` for canonical OpenNeuro fetching. This introduces a silent drift from the verified data source constraint, risking data integrity violations.

Task T039 implements the FR-014 sensitivity analysis using vague placeholders '{low, medium, high}' for the spatial smoothing kernel. The Spec (FR-014) explicitly requires a quantitative sweep of σ ∈ {5, 10, 15} mm. This semantic weakening of the requirement violates the deterministic constraint of exact parameter specification.

Task T047 instructs the implementer to 'override obsolete SC-002 text' to use Dice > 0.6 AND TOST p < 0.05. The Spec (SC-002) defines a different logic (Overlap > 0.6 AND p > 0.05 for domain-general). While the Plan notes a potential amendment, the Task unilaterally alters the Success Criterion without a ratified spec change, constituting a retroactive narrowing of the acceptance criteria.

Tasks T055-T057 propose drafting a 'Constitution Amendment' to substitute behavioral measures with split-half reliability for Principle VII. The Spec (Assumptions & FR-013) and Plan already explicitly authorize this substitution as a valid proxy. Creating a task to 'amend' a principle that the Spec already compliantly addresses is a semantic drift that implies the current spec is non-compliant, violating the 'Single Source of Truth' where the Spec is the authority.

Task T048 requires validating data against `data/manifest.json`. The Spec (Constitution Principle III) and Plan mandate checksums be recorded in `state/projects/...yaml`. Introducing a new `manifest.json` artifact without spec authorization creates a silent drift in the Data Hygiene protocol, violating the constraint that all data hygiene must follow the defined state/manifest structure.
